Name: Playground Mod
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you make full use of the Pelican Town playground:

[list]
[*]Sitting on the swings causes them to swing back and forth.
[*]Moving up towards the slide ladder causes the player to climb up and slide down the slide.
[*]Sitting on the rocking duck causes it to sway back and forth.
[/list]
[youtube]oAdaJ3dESjs[/youtube]


You can change the sounds and speeds in the config. 

You can edit the config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.


[b][size=5]Custom Tilesheets[/size][/b]

If you are using a town map with custom tilesheets, the playground may not look correct. You can override the png files used to draw the playground using Content Patcher. Target the following paths [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide/action-editimage.md]using an [b]EditImage[/b] action[/url]:

[b]aedenthorn.PlaygroundMod/swing[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.PlaygroundMod/slide[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.PlaygroundMod/spring[/b]

You can find the mod's png files in the assets folder. Make sure you copy the sizes, they are not standard tile-sized graphics.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
